title: Converting Markdown
purpose: Turns Markdown into Jira wiki markup (Jira Data Center), Atlassian Document Format (Jira Cloud and Confluence Cloud) or Confluence storage format (Confluence Data Center), and any of those back into Markdown.
inputs: A document in the workspace, stdin, or `--text`, with `--to` to convert Markdown into a format, or `--from` to convert a format into Markdown.
verifies: Every result is converted back and compared with what you gave it, block by block, and `lossless` says whether anything was lost. ADF output is checked against Atlassian's schema, and storage output read back as XML, before it's returned, so a document Jira would refuse never comes back.
limits: Anything the other format can't hold, like a task list in wiki markup, a panel, a mention or a merged cell, is listed in `losses` with where it was. Raw HTML, link reference definitions and footnotes aren't read. How each product's own renderer shows the result hasn't been checked against a live instance.
